messages:
emily: Heads-up — ran into a confusing error surface in the Go sample app while onboarding a customer. A 502 from hosted inference shows up as a generic 'server error' string with no retry hint. Repro on commit abc123.

raj: ack. we should map 502/503 -> TransientServerError with a `retry_hint` field (and prefer a Retry-After if provided). right now Python SDK surfaces that better than Go.

samir: yep saw that. Go's client currently returns errors.New("server error") in a few codepaths. we need typed errors (RateLimitError, AuthError, TransientServerError, FatalError) so callers can programmatically decide backoff.

emily: agreed. also the sample app prints the raw body: `{"error":"server_error","message":"unknown"}` which is unhelpful. can we canonicalize message text to include cause + next steps? e.g. "Transient server error (502) — retry with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts"

jing: small nuance on auth: 401 should be AuthError and non-retriable by default, but if our SDK can auto-refresh token once and then retry transparently, the user sees none of it. need to document behavior.

raj: propose:
- typed exceptions in all SDKs (Go + JS + Rust parity) with stable names
- SDK exposes `.retryable` boolean + `.retry_after_seconds` + `.server_code`
- sample app shows best-practice: refresh auth once, then exponential backoff 500ms * 2^n up to 8s, max 3 retries for transient codes

samir: love it. small API surface note: keep HTTP status -> error class mapping deterministic:
- 401 -> AuthError
- 403 -> PermissionError
- 429 -> RateLimitError (include quota bucket)
- 502/503 -> TransientServerError
- 500 -> FatalError unless body indicates transient

emily: +1. also make error.message human-first: short summary + specific hint. e.g. "Rate limit exceeded — reduce batch size or increase quota. See /docs/rate-limits"

jing: we should also include a consistent error.code string (snake_case) for telemetry and docs linking. e.g. `rate_limit_exceeded`, `transient_gateway_error`. keeps searchability in logs.

devx-bot: created ticket DE-789: "SDK error ergonomics — typed exceptions, retry_hint parity, sample app updates" and linked to PR template. :white_check_mark:

raj: planning PR: add new error types to Go, wire mapping, update sample app to show backoff + token refresh. will add migration notes in changelog.

samir: quick question — do we want the SDK to automatically retry on 429? i think we should not auto-retry unless token bucket headers indicate quick recovery (Retry-After short). otherwise expensive hidden retries are bad.

emily: agreed. default: no automatic retry for 429 unless `auto_retry_rate_limit=true` opt-in. but 502/503 can auto-retry with exponential backoff bounded. documentable flag.

jing: will draft docs snippet for onboarding: code example + expected error shapes + table mapping HTTP -> exception name + retry guidance. i'll drop it in the docs PR.

raj: timeline: aim for branch + unit tests this week, sample app change and doc draft next. anyone want to take ownership of the sample app wording?

emily: I'll take the sample app wording + one-liner error copy. i'll keep it concise and prescriptive. :rocket:

samir: I'll do Go SDK changes and tests. ping me for review.

devx-bot: DE-789 status set to In Progress by raj.

emily: thanks all. small follow-ups: add examples of bad vs good error messages in the ticket, and include a recommended client-side snippet for exponential backoff. that should reduce support noise. :+1:
